data.one_liner: Loggy extension to use 'developer.log' with pretty printer in Flutter
data.what_it_does: It provides a Loggy extension for Flutter to use developer.log alongside a pretty printer. It helps format and output logs cleanly within a Flutter application.
use_when: You are already using Loggy for logging in your Flutter application
You want to use developer.log with a pretty printer in Flutter
avoid_when: You are not using the Loggy package
you prefer standard print or other logging solutions without Loggy
strengths: Provides pretty printing for developer.log in Flutter
weaknesses: Extremely limited documentation in the README
Depends entirely on the Loggy package ecosystem
